item.title: Lara Dutta and daughter Saira escape Dubai chaos and land safely in Mumbai
item.description: Bollywood actor Lara Dutta and daughter Saira returned to Mumbai after a scary escape from Dubai amid Middle East tensions. Living near bombed Jebel Ali Port, they drove to Fujairah airport hearing explosions. “Felt like Airlift 2,” Lara said, posting a video fearing it could be her last. “Hats off to airlines,” she added, worried about daughter’s trauma.

item.title: PM Modi to release 22nd installment of PM Kisan Samman Nidhi in Assam : Here is the exact amount farmers will get
item.description: PM Narendra Modi is all set to release the 22nd installment of the PM Kisan Samman Nidhi on Friday at 5 pm. The amount will be released by the PM at a programme in Guwahati in Assam. A total of Rs 18,640 crore will be sent directly to the bank accounts of the farmers in India under this scheme.

item.title: Friday the 13th: The Chilling story behind the world’s unluckiest day
item.description: Why does Friday the 13th inspire fear across cultures? From Biblical references and ancient superstitions to the influence of iconic horror films, this ominous date blends religion, myth and cinema to create one of the world’s most enduring paranormal beliefs.

item.title: Want to go on a holiday in summer? Indian Railways lines up 1,484 special trains
item.description: Every year, there is a rush of travelers who set out to enjoy the summer holidays. This year Indian Railways will run 1,484 summer special trains, which include 749 reserved and 735 unreserved services.
